name: Dwarf
description: Faeries living in communities guarding the entrances to the earth (caves, barrows, mines); cunning smiths with access to the Earth's treasures who can grant External Vis to other faeries.

name: Gnome
description: Term not used in Mythic Europe except perhaps for earth elementals; gnome-like creatures with pointy red hats have various local names.

name: Goblin
description: General term for a subterranean faerie of destructive bent found in caves or mines, or a malicious faerie of short stature; prone to taking children for changelings.

name: Barbegazi
description: All-male dwarfs of the snows living in mountaintop burrows, with icicle beards and broad feet; their cries cause avalanches.

name: Dvergar
description: Norse dwarves originally maggots in the corpse of Ymir, given intelligence by the gods; they flee sunlight and crafted the treasures of the gods.

name: Karzełek
description: Polish dwarfs with green grass for hair who ride diminutive horses over sleeping field hands; they aid diligent farmers but punish minor infractions violently.

name: Knockers
description: Cornish mine faeries said to warn miners of collapses by knocking, playing along with belief that they are souls of dead Jewish miners.

name: Kobolds
description: German mine faeries that lace mines with arsenical ore and cause minor trouble, though some are helpful.

name: Faun
description: Lustful faeries; twisted fauns prowl the borders of Infernal spaces and are virtually indistinguishable from demons; they hold bacchanalian parties with nymphs.

name: Butatschah-iglis
description: A Swiss lake faerie pretending to be a demon: a vast amorphous sack covered in fire-beaming eyes that eats fish and fishermen, guarding a supposed gateway to Hell.

name: Giant
description: Huge humanoid faeries (giants, ogres, trolls) that typically guard spaces in faerie stories; unlike Magical giants they are drawn to humans, harvest vitality through terror, and regenerate.

name: Cliff Ogres
description: Large faeries haunting cliff-top roads who throw travelers onto rocks for their children to eat.

name: Dev
description: Armenian giants with up to seven one-eyed heads; some can change into dragons or other monsters.

name: Gello
description: An Italian ogress whose breasts drain the blood of children; Vulnerable to the Divine since three missionaries forced her to return a child's blood.

name: Kinderschrecker
description: German child-eating ogress ('child guzzler'), a version of the Gello without exsanguinating breasts.

name: Guardian of the Fishes
description: A huge, human-shaped scaled faerie of the Baltic Sea with fish fins, gills and eyes, which rarely leaves the water.

name: Jack's Beanstalk Giant
description: A hammy giant who knowingly lets a boy become famous by killing him, assisted by a wife who gives magic beans; the most anachronistic faerie in the book.

name: Red Ettin
description: A three-headed giant who imprisoned the princess of Scotland, can turn people to stone and smell humans; answering his riddles is his Sovereign Ward.

name: Troll
description: A term with divergent meanings: a barrow-faerie ancestral spirit, a shaggy solitary giant of northern Scandinavia turned to stone by sunlight, or a small social faerie of southern Scandinavia.

name: Trow
description: Little mound-dwelling faeries of Orkney that dance under the stars and steal musicians; linked to changeling exchanges.

name: Muilearteach
description: A sea giantess who comes ashore in storms as a begging hag and devours those who shelter her; she has a pot of healing ointment.

name: Multiheaded Giants
description: Giants found across Mythic Europe whose heads each have their own personality, making them either easily confused or incredibly cunning.

name: Vörys-mort
description: An enormous, extremely swift giant who can look over the forest and sometimes drives animals toward hunters' traps on the Volga.

name: Orm
description: A class of predominantly faerie dragons ('worms'): vast venomous snakes that crave vital things such as cows' milk or virgins and often poison their surroundings.

name: Alklha
description: A vast Siberian dragon that seems to swallow the Sun; sliced in half by shamans, its lower body hidden under a ward; it can dispel Sun duration effects by licking them.

name: Gwiber
description: A Welsh dragon that begins as an orm and grows leathery wings after tasting human breast milk; may form a milk-brother bond with a human infant.

name: Horse-Headed Serpents
description: Great water serpents with the heads or forequarters of horses, red or yellow eyes and fangs.

name: Kalshedra
description: An Albanian fire-breathing dragon that can take hag shape, pollutes water, causes drought and feeds on human vitality.

name: Pisuhänd
description: A small dragon of the Baltic coast that acts like a brownie.

name: Tatzelwurm
description: An Alpine dragon two to six feet long with a catlike head, lizard body without hind legs, and toxic breath.

name: Stollenwurm
description: The tunnel worm, a far longer variant of the tatzelwurm that rears up and attacks with its foreclaws.

name: Vishap
description: A Mastery Faerie dragon atop Mount Ararat whose blood is so poisonous that weapons that injured it slay with a scratch.

name: Vouivre
description: A creature with a green two-legged dragon's hindparts and a woman's foreparts, with a single gemstone eye; it guards a treasure hoard and bathes once a year.

name: Wivere
description: A wingless, legless French dragon whose Sovereign Ward is that it cannot harm naked people.

name: Brownie
description: A helpful household faerie expecting a dish of milk; can be jealous of babies and taint them with Faerie Blood.

name: Portune
description: A helpful household faerie, like a brownie.

name: Bloodcap
description: Frightening faeries of cruel winter that haunt places where blood has been shed and feed on fear.

name: Ettin
description: Brutish Germanic giants (also called ogres or trolls) of Size +3 to +5, harmed by sunlight; their females are troll-wives.

name: Troll-wife
description: Often beautiful female ettins who take heroic husbands and bear powerful magicians, or steal Gifted children.

name: Ghula
description: Rapacious wasteland faeries of the Arabic world whose unions with human men produce ghula daughters or ghul-blooded sons.

name: Huldra
description: A Scandinavian nymph, beautiful in front but hollow-backed with a cow's tail, able to vanish when unobserved; male form is huldu or huldrekall.

name: Nymph
description: Faeries haunting the borders of human settlement, archetypal sexual predators attracted to young men; they abduct nympholepts.

name: Padfoot
description: A faerie in the form of an immense black dog with glowing green eyes that protects travelers despite its fearsome reputation.

name: Satyr
description: Lustful faeries who hold bacchanalian parties with nymphs; boys conceived there have satyr blood.

name: Selkie
description: Seal-faeries who can be trapped by mortal men as brides, raise children, and almost always regain freedom.

name: Swanmaiden
description: Close cousins of the selkies who can be trapped by mortal men as brides.

name: Sidhe
description: Irish name for courtly faeries; highly cognizant ones seek humans to produce children partaking of their nature.

name: Faerie Knight
description: Courtly faeries of stories who have passionate encounters with mortal women and later marry them honorably.

name: Glanconer
description: Sinister courtly faeries who abduct maidens from their homes.

name: Undine
description: Courtly faeries inhabiting rivers, especially boundary rivers, progenitors of mortal lineages like the rulers of Lusignan.

name: Mermaid
description: A water-inhabiting faerie for which Undine Blood can substitute.

name: Changeling
description: A faerie child, ancient faerie, or carved stock left in place of a stolen human infant, disguised with glamour.

name: Faerie Homunculus
description: A faerie homunculus whose bond grants a Homunculus Wizard a Faerie version of The Gift.

name: Ymir
description: The Norse giant from whose corpse the world was made; the dvergar were maggots in his corpse.

name: Fafnir
description: Son of the dwarf king who can turn himself into a dragon to express his greed for treasure.

name: Jerbiton
description: Founder of the Order whose diaries reveal the truth about the Swiss lake and its supposed Infernal gateway.

name: Mercere
description: Founder whose grandchild is said to have married a bloodcap and raised her children as Redcaps.

name: Merlin
description: Clothed Uther Pendragon in glamour so he appeared to be Igraine's husband.

name: Uther Pendragon
description: Given the appearance of Igraine's husband by Merlin's glamour.

name: King Arthur
description: Son of Igraine, conceived through Merlin's glamour trick.

name: Igraine
description: King Arthur's mother, deceived by Merlin's glamour.

name: Mélusine
description: Undine ancestor of the rulers of Lusignan castle.

name: Aelfred
description: A local faerie doctor used in the example of Curse-Throwing to cure a young woman's barrenness.

name: Zeus
description: Old god, a powerful faerie whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Venus
description: Old goddess, a powerful faerie whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Morrigan
description: Old goddess, a powerful faerie whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Odin
description: Old god, a powerful faerie whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Pelos
description: Old god whose descendants may bear Faerie God Blood.

name: Thoth
description: Egyptian god identified with Hermes, whose sacred ibis had gwiber-like rivals.

name: Balaam's ass
description: Biblical animal cited as one God chose to imbue with a soul.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie realm where dwarfs also dwell.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The game setting in which the faeries described are found.

name: Swiss Gateway Lake
description: A lake in Switzerland said to have a gateway to Hell, actually created by a magical battle after the fall of the Western Empire.

name: Mount Ararat
description: Mountain on whose top the dragon Vishap resides.

name: Forest of Luchon
description: Forest at the foot of the Pyrenees in France where gem-faced serpents, children of a vouivre, are found.

name: Pyrenees
description: Mountains in France at whose foot lies the forest of Luchon.

name: Lusignan Castle
description: Castle whose rulers descend from the undine Mélusine.

name: Baltic Sea
description: Home of the Guardian of the Fishes and the pisuhänd.

name: Volga
description: Region where Vörys-mort assists hunters.

name: Orkney
description: Islands where trows dwell.

name: Western Empire
description: Empire after whose fall the Swiss lake was created by a magical battle.

name: Faerie
description: The Faerie realm, whose touch changes humans, grants sympathy, and underlies faerie hedge magic.

name: Magic
description: Magic realm; Magical giants and dragons differ from faerie ones.

name: Divine
description: The Divine realm; Divine areas have faerie monsters on their edges.

name: Infernal
description: The Infernal realm; twisted fauns prowl the borders of Infernal spaces.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House whose members' human and animal forms are both true forms, so True Sight cannot detect them.

name: Redcaps
description: Messengers of the Order; one is said to be descended from a bloodcap, another sells Gifted ettin-blooded children.

name: Quaesitores
description: Hermetic investigators whose ire an evil-reputed covenant may raise.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Order to whose members a Redcap sells Gifted children, in violation of the Code.

name: Code of Hermes
description: The Code, which specifies that magi must not molest the fae.

name: Faerie Doctor
description: A human intermediary between peasants and faeries in Saxon lands, also called a lybman, who heals with faerie powers like Curse-Throwing and dowsing; also a Special Virtue making the character a Mythic Companion.

name: Mythic Companion
description: A character type granted by the Faerie Doctor Virtue.

name: Nympholept
description: Young men taken by nymphs for years who gain Faerie Blood and often prophetic powers.

name: Milk Brother
description: A human who shared milk with a gwiber, gaining Animal Ken and a Faerie Friend bond with it.

name: Faerie Wizard
description: Faerie hedge wizards whose powers can depend on faeries assisting them and on Faerie Rank.

name: Faerie Might
description: Might score of faerie creatures, aligned with a Form such as Corpus or Animal.

name: Sympathy
description: A supernatural connection to things a faerie represents, left when faeries draw vitality from humans; enables faerie hedge wizardry.

name: Sympathy Trait
description: A Trait describing a character's faerie relationship to a class of subjects, usable as a specialization bonus; negative Traits impose penalties and botch dice.

name: Faerie Rank
description: The character's highest positive Sympathy Trait modified by the lowest negative one, measuring strength of connection to Faerie.

name: Sympathetic Influence
description: Temporarily gaining a Sympathy Trait via ceremonial influence (a faerie ritual) or practical influence (a season of association).

name: Tinted Aura
description: A Faerie aura given Personality Traits by tinting, imposing temporary traits on all within it.

name: Charm
description: A product of human creative effort tied to activating a Virtue, whose power depends on secrecy.

name: Folk Charm
description: A crafted charm made by a character with Faerie Lore and a Sympathy Trait that can end a faerie effect.

name: Hermetic Charm
description: Use of Sympathy Traits in Hermetic lab work and enchanted devices designed as charms that must be activated in secret.

name: Glamour
description: Faerie power used to disguise, create armor, and produce Faerie Blood in mortals.

name: Vitality
description: The human energy faeries harvest, e.g. through terror, fertility, or hosting.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: A faerie's weakness condition; e.g. Red Ettin can be killed by one who answers his riddles, Wivere cannot harm naked people. Also a Major Flaw.

name: Mastery Faerie
description: A classification of faerie applied to the dragon Vishap.

name: Warping
description: Supernatural distortion; Warping Score limits Sympathy Trait growth and botches can give Warping Points.

name: Faerie Calling
description: A Warping result for faerie magicians, analogous to Twilight, that can grant Sympathy Traits.

name: Twilight
description: Experienced by Hermetic magi as they are warped.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link used to guide characters or represent a curse recipient; distinct from sympathy.

name: Faerie Aura
description: Supernatural aura of the Faerie realm that can be tinted and adds to rolls.

name: Faerie Regio
description: A faerie regio in which a nymph imprisons a captured woman.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that faerie effects and curse-throwing must penetrate.

name: Penetration
description: Total needed to overcome Magic Resistance; Sympathy Traits can add to it.

name: Realm Interaction Table
description: Chart determining realm bonuses; Hermetic charms may be treated as Magic or Faerie.

name: Essential Nature
description: Hermetic concept which magi conclude does not limit the Faerie realm as it limits Magic.

name: Cognizance
description: Degree of faerie self-awareness (incognizant, narrowly, highly cognizant), affecting Faerie Blood strength.

name: Faerie Power
description: Faerie abilities such as Beguile, Conjure, Dream, Grant, Portage, Ware, Weal and Woe usable as Virtues.

name: Faerie Method
description: Faerie wizardry methods such as Empathy, Enchantment and Evocation.

name: Faerie Hedge Wizardry
description: Traditions of faerie magic enabled by sympathy; each tradition has four Favored Abilities.

name: Favored Abilities
description: Four Abilities of a faerie hedge tradition that initiates learn without usual penalties.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's talisman can be attuned to Sympathy Traits appropriate to its shape or material.

name: Stock
description: A crudely carved wooden image left in place of a stolen infant.

name: Rhine Gold
description: Treasure cursed by a dwarf, contributing to Ragnarok.

name: Vouivre's Eye
description: The vouivre's single gemstone eye, believed able to turn iron into gold.

name: Ragnarok
description: The Norse doom to which the curse on the Rhine gold contributes.

name: Deprivation
description: Rolls required when deprived of air or water.

name: Confidence Point
description: Resource spent in ceremonial influence; a Sympathy experience reward may replace one.

name: Vis
description: Raw magic found in faerie bodies, e.g. giants' bones or orm snakeskins.

name: Dominion
description: The Divine aura that northern trolls are unable to face.

name: Lyb-craeft
description: Magical healing and surgery practised by lybmen (faerie doctors).

name: The Gift
description: Hermetic talent, incompatible with Faerie Doctor and required for Homunculus Wizard.

name: Bloodcap Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety from bloodcaps granting a Strength bonus.

name: Brownie Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a bonus to Profession totals.

name: Dwarf Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a bonus to Craft totals.

name: Ettin Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting Stamina, with sunlight vulnerability.

name: Faerie God Blood
description: Faerie Blood from old gods, granting points in Sympathy Traits.

name: Ghul Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting retractable claws.

name: Goblin Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a bonus to stealth totals.

name: Huldra Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety allowing invisibility when still.

name: Nymph Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a Communication bonus.

name: Padfoot Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a Perception bonus.

name: Satyr Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting Communication and Presence bonuses with sexually compatible characters.

name: Selkie Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety granting a bonus to avoid Deprivation.

name: Sidhe Blood
description: The most common Faerie Blood variety, from courtly faeries, granting a Presence bonus.

name: Undine Blood
description: Faerie Blood variety from river courtly faeries granting underwater bonuses.

name: External Vis
description: Virtue dwarfs can grant to other faeries.

name: Faerie Blood
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue of faerie ancestry; also raises max Sympathy Trait score by 1.

name: Strong Faerie Blood
description: Major Supernatural Virtue of potent faerie ancestry, raising max Sympathy Traits by 3.

name: Faerie Legacy
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue enhancing the benefit of Faerie Blood.

name: Faerie Sympathy
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Virtue granting a positive Sympathy Trait.

name: Faerie Background
description: Free Supernatural Virtue granting a positive and negative Sympathy Trait from an unusual birth or childhood.

name: Faerie Doctor (Virtue)
description: Special Virtue making the character a Mythic Companion with free Dowsing.

name: Familiarity with the Fae
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue giving +2 to social rolls with faeries.

name: Frightful Presence
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue instilling dread through appearance.

name: Greater Benediction
description: Major Supernatural Virtue: a supernatural blessing like Flight, True Sight, Universally Liked.

name: Lesser Benediction
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue: a lesser blessing like Gift of the Gab or Green Fingers.

name: Beguile
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting the Beguile Faerie Power.

name: Bonding
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Bonding.

name: Captivating
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Captivating.

name: Ceremony
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue and Supernatural Ability that pools participants to boost faerie effects (Faerie Ceremony).

name: Conjure
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting the Conjure Faerie Power.

name: Curse-Throwing
description: Major Supernatural Virtue and Ability to cure diseases and curses by transferring them to another.

name: Dismissing
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Dismissing.

name: Dream
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting the Dream Faerie Power.

name: Empathy
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting the Empathy Faerie Method.

name: Enchantment
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting the Enchantment Faerie Method.

name: Evocation
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting the Evocation Faerie Method.

name: Grant
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue/Faerie Power by which faeries teach charms and Virtues.

name: Portage
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Portage.

name: Summoning
description: Major Supernatural Virtue granting Summoning.

name: Ware
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Ware.

name: Weal
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Weal.

name: Woe
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue granting Woe.

name: Flight (Benediction)
description: Example Greater Benediction allowing wingless flight with a prop.

name: True Sight
description: Example Greater Benediction seeing through glamour and shapechanges.

name: Universally Liked
description: Example Greater Benediction giving social bonuses.

name: Gift of the Gab
description: Example Lesser Benediction making the speaker convincing.

name: Green Fingers
description: Example Lesser Benediction making plants prosper.

name: Pricking Thumbs
description: Example Lesser Benediction sensing ill will.

name: Unusually Fecund
description: Example Lesser Benediction ensuring conception.

name: Second Sight
description: Virtue often gained by children who briefly stayed with faeries.

name: Dowsing
description: Virtue granted free to faerie doctors, locating water and lost things.

name: Animal Ken
description: Virtue granting understanding of animals, gained by gwiber milk-brothers.

name: Premonitions
description: Prophetic Virtue common to nympholepts.

name: Death Prophecy
description: Virtue representing linked-life changelings.

name: Entrancement
description: Supernatural Virtue, example of a charmed Virtue.

name: Greater Immunity
description: Virtue, e.g. to Fire or Drowning.

name: Light Touch
description: Virtue, example of a charmed Virtue.

name: Puissant (Ability)
description: Virtue giving bonus to an Ability; e.g. Puissant Single Weapon, Stealth, Charm, Swim, Etiquette.

name: Reserves of Strength
description: Virtue, example of a charmed Virtue.

name: Keen Vision
description: Virtue permissible as a charmed Virtue.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue that cannot be charmed.

name: Common Sense
description: Virtue whose effects Familiarity with the Fae grants regarding faeries.

name: Huge
description: Faerie Virtue of size, taken by giants and orms.

name: Faerie Sight
description: Faerie Virtue.

name: Faerie Speech
description: Faerie Virtue and Ability allowing faeries to speak.

name: Human Form
description: Faerie Virtue taken by giants.

name: Increased Might
description: Faerie Virtue.

name: Place of Power
description: Faerie Virtue for a giant in its lair.

name: Faerie Beast
description: Faerie Virtue taken by orms.

name: Highly Cognizant
description: Faerie Virtue.

name: Personal Faerie Powers
description: Faerie Virtue granting powers like Constant Damaging Effect or Flight.

name: Focus Power
description: Major faerie Virtue available to Strong Faerie Blooded humans.

name: Greater Power
description: Major faerie Virtue.

name: Improved Powers
description: Minor faerie Virtue.

name: Lesser Power
description: Minor faerie Virtue.

name: Ways of the (Land)
description: Virtue; Ways of the Forest, Desert or Sea.

name: Great Presence
description: Virtue.

name: Skinchanger
description: Virtue of shapechanging into animals.

name: Giant Blood
description: Virtue suggested for ettin-blooded characters.

name: Venus' Blessing
description: Virtue suggested for sidhe-blooded characters.

name: Wilderness Sense
description: Virtue.

name: Enchanting Music
description: Virtue suggested for satyr-blooded characters.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Virtue.

name: Incognizant
description: Flaw of faeries lacking self-awareness.

name: Faerie Antipathy
description: Major or Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a negative Sympathy Trait.

name: Faerie Heritage
description: Major Story Flaw: birth engineered by a highly cognizant faerie.

name: Faerie Metamorphosis
description: Minor Supernatural or Hermetic Flaw developing a glamour when Warping reaches 1.

name: Faerie Upbringing
description: Minor General Flaw for children raised among faeries, raising max Sympathy Traits.

name: Greater Charm
description: Major Story Flaw: a Virtue ruled by a single stealable charm.

name: Lesser Charm
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw: a Virtue activated by a secret ritual charm.

name: Homunculus Wizard
description: Major Story or Hermetic Flaw: a Faerie version of The Gift through a homunculus.

name: Greater Malediction
description: Flaw typically resulting from faerie interaction.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw typically resulting from faerie interaction.

name: Monstrous Appearance
description: Major faerie Flaw.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Minor faerie Flaw.

name: Reduced Power
description: Minor faerie Flaw.

name: Slow Power
description: Minor faerie Flaw.

name: Faerie Friend
description: Flaw of amicable bond with a faerie, e.g. gwiber or changeling.

name: Mistaken Identity
description: Flaw of hostile linked-life relationship with a changeling.

name: Ability Block
description: Flaw making certain Abilities unavailable, common with Faerie Upbringing.

name: Visions
description: Prophetic Flaw of nympholepts.

name: Disfigured
description: Flaw.

name: Vulnerable to the Divine
description: Faerie weakness of Gello.

name: Curse of Venus
description: Flaw.

name: Nocturnal
description: Flaw.

name: Small Frame
description: Flaw.

name: Dwarf (Flaw)
description: Flaw suggested for dwarf-blooded characters.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Flaw.

name: Feral Upbringing
description: Flaw.

name: Fragile Constitution
description: Flaw.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Brawl
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Single Weapon
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Thrown Weapon
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Awareness
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Carouse
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Folk Ken
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Area Lore
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Hunt
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Stealth
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Charm (Ability)
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Bargain
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Church Lore
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Dominion Lore
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Etiquette
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Guile
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Leadership
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Ride
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Theology
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Concentration
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Profession
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Craft
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Hex
description: Ability referenced in faerie rules and statistics.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form or Technique in faerie rules.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form or Technique in faerie rules.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form or Technique in faerie rules.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form or Technique in faerie rules.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form or Technique in faerie rules.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form or Technique in faerie rules.

name: Constrict
description: Orm natural power encoiling a victim, dealing automatic damage until broken free.

name: Constant Damaging Effect
description: Orm Personal Faerie Power emitting noxious slime or toxic breath for +5 Damage.

name: Venomous Bite
description: Orm natural power inflicting adder venom.

name: Flight (Faerie Power)
description: Personal Faerie Power of gwibers and flying orms.
